title: fix(models): warn when policy substitutes the configured default
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: the agent silently runs a different model when a wildcard model visibility policy excludes the configured default.

## User Impact

Operators now get a warning that names the requested model, the model selected instead, and the policy to repair, while automatic selection and explicit override rejection behave as before.

## Why This Change Was Made

The shared visibility-policy selector already picked the first permitted catalog model, but it returned that substitute without saying why. The selector now emits the diagnostic at the point of that choice, using sanitized model refs. The existing warning and sanitization helpers moved into a sibling module because the original owner was over the repository line cap, so the selector itself gets smaller.

Production LOC +69/-32 (net +37), including the warning extraction; tests +58/-0; docs +1/-0. No config, SDK, protocol, schema, dependency, or selection-policy change.

## Evidence

- Red on main: the new wildcard-policy regression in `src/agents/model-visibility-policy.test.ts` failed because no warning was emitted.
- Green before the warning extraction: 92 tests passed across five suites covering the visibility policy, ordinary reply selection, command selection, plugin tool execution, and heartbeat override rejection.
- Green after the extraction: 74 tests passed across `model-visibility-policy`, `model-selection`, and `model-selection.acp-runtime`, including the existing unqualified and unresolved model warnings and ACP suppression.
- Targeted typecheck, oxlint, oxfmt, the line-cap ratchet, and `git diff --check` passed.
- Independent review: clean, no actionable findings.
- Gap: no running Gateway, real provider, or live channel was used; proof stops at the shared selection boundary and its consumers, so PR CI remains the broad proof.

Fixes #103520
